propositions: Plan-review and completion-verification latency and reliability degrade materially for tickets with descriptions above 8,000 characters (p99 7,500 chars, only 0.82% of 2,202 historical tickets affected).

Description length exceeding a configurable [verify] maximum-description setting (default 8,000 chars, boundary at exactly 8,000 allowed, 8,001 blocked) must be blocking rather than advisory at both plan-review and completion-verification gates.

Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before LLM execution; light-bug review must partition DET blocks to retain only blocking P4 description findings while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.

Completion verification must check authoritative ticket description against the configured maximum before child checks or context assembly, returning deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls if exceeded.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; oversizing produces at most one P4 finding; no truncation or summarization is permitted as mitigation.
